exposure: Online delivery of the 'Books Together' dialogic book sharing programme
cohort: 44 parents of 3-5-year-old children who were initially recruited for an RCT and offered an online version of the 'Books Together' program due to COVID-19.
finding: The online delivery of the 'Books Together' program was found to be feasible with high parent completion and satisfaction, and it achieved significant post-intervention increases in parenting competence, well-being, child prosocial behavior, and social/emotional ability.
